runs.notes: W30 scan (Tue 2026-07-21). BACKLOG CATCH-UP: no scan or deep run had executed since 2026-06-18 (scan_2026-W25_002), a 33-day gap, so the PubMed window was widened from 7 to 35 days across 8 queries. 135 unique PMIDs surfaced; 8 already in DB, 4 previously dropped, 123 new candidates triaged; 33 added, ~90 dropped as out-of-scope (BCRL/ILR/LYMPHA, gynecologic and head-and-neck cancer LE, melanoma groin dissection, lymphatic filariasis and podoconiosis, lipedema, venous/phlebolymphedema, 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, and off-topic items). HEADLINE: pm_42383350 (J Clin Invest) identifies mechanoreceptor PLXND1 as a lymphatic endothelial mechanosensor required for lymphatic valve morphogenesis, with PLXND1 missense variants found in a primary-lymphedema patient screen and two functionally validated as pathogenic - the only item clearing the alert threshold (importance 8 / evidence 6). SECOND GENETICS ITEM: pm_42454412 SHOC2 as a novel cause of central conducting lymphatic anomaly (n=1 VUS + zebrafish), notable for a NEGATIVE trametinib response with immunoblot evidence pointing to non-canonical mTOR rather than RAS-MAPK signalling - a caution against assuming MEK-inhibitor benefit in RASopathy-associated CCLA. Extends the existing mtor_mek_neonatal_lymphatic_anomalies finding, as does pm_42332051 (sirolimus for neonatal non-immune hydrops, no abstract indexed). OTHER THEMES: developmental lymphatic anomalies well represented (pm_42432577 n=478 pediatric LM cohort - surgery vs sclerotherapy no significant difference; pm_42429287 fetal LM natural history; pm_42319544 robotic abdominal LM resection); imaging/biomarker cluster (pm_42469309 serum ICG quantification incl. VEGFR3-haploinsufficient model; pm_41883042 23Na-MRI tissue sodium falls after CDT while limb circumference does not - follow-on to pm_42286847; pm_42434084 randomised-order S-CUPS vs D-CUPS; pm_41579179 HFUS+CEUS mapping); cellulitis as patient-important endpoint (pm_41275489 SR: 25 studies, only 1 RCT; pm_42475483 Australasian equipoise survey ahead of a planned RCT - added to watchlist); surgical evidence gap reinforced (pm_42364799 debulking criteria, only 5 studies/933 pts; pm_42379295 liposuction candidacy, 7 studies; pm_41997536 IPC RCT systematic review found only 7 lower-extremity RCTs vs 21 upper-extremity). PRIMARY-SPECIFIC SURGICAL DATA: pm_42085896 VLNT recipient-site series (n=51) reports the multilevel-inset advantage concentrated in the primary-lymphedema subgroup - exploratory, volume-only, 12 months, weight not controlled. pm_41881324 (n=2031 multidisciplinary lymphatic centre) quantifies a mean 9.5-year diagnostic delay and stratifies primary vs secondary etiology. TRIALS: all 22 tracked NCTs checked; NO status, phase or results changes. Most recent lastUpdatePostDate is NCT07558317 at 2026-05-06, predating the window. ALERTS: 1 written to output/alerts/2026-07-21-alert.md (pm_42383350 only). papers.json 413 -> 446. Backup: data/papers.bak-2026-07-21-scan.json. NOTE: the 2026-05-21 re-baseline scope-filter data-integrity issue (flagged in deep_2026-W24_001) remains OUTSTANDING - roughly 130 secondary/off-topic papers still pollute papers.json and should be re-classified and purged before the next deep synthesis. ROOT CAUSE OF THE 33-DAY GAP (confirmed from output/logs/): the launchd agents DID fire on schedule; all 17 intervening runs failed. 2026-06-20 to 2026-07-16: twelve scan and four deep runs died immediately on '401 Invalid authentication credentials', then 2026-07-18 on '401 OAuth access token has expired'. Re-auth appears to have occurred ~2026-07-18. 2026-07-19 onward: with auth restored, the deep run (2026-07-19) and today's 08:00 scan both failed on a permission rule of the WRONG KIND - '.claude/settings.local.json' allows Write(<root>/*), but Write(path) rules are not consulted by file permission checks; only Edit(path) rules are. This is NOT the glob-width issue previously recorded in project memory, and widening * to ** alone would not fix it. The correct two-line fix is already staged in settings.local.FIXED.json (widen Write to ** AND add Edit(<root>/**)) and remains UNAPPLIED - deliberately not self-applied, as it widens the agent's own write permissions. Until applied, every automated run will keep failing at its first file write. The 2026-07-19 deep run additionally stopped by design on the scope-pollution issue rather than synthesise over polluted data and sync it to Google Drive.
